mapper.select: SELECT ea.id, ea.drug_id, ea.hospital_id, ea.inventory_id, ea.batch_no, ea.expire_date, ea.days_until_expiry, ea.status, ea.created_at, ea.updated_at, d.name AS drug_name, d.code AS drug_code, d.spec, d.unit, h.name AS hospital_name FROM drug_expiry_alert ea LEFT JOIN drug_info d ON ea.drug_id = d.id LEFT JOIN hospital h ON ea.hospital_id = h.id WHERE ea.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY ea.days_until_expiry ASC

SELECT id, drug_id, hospital_id, inventory_id, batch_no, expire_date, days_until_expiry, status, created_at, updated_at FROM drug_expiry_alert WHERE inventory_id = #{inventoryId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' LIMIT 1
